cards.text: Jesus is in Jerusalem, teaching in the temple courts. The leaders there wanted Him arrested, but they were afraid of the crowd, so they try something else. They send some Pharisees, strict keepers of the law, and some Herodians, supporters of Herod's family.

cards.question: The leaders send these Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus. What are they sent to do?

answers.text: Catch Jesus in His words
Ask Jesus to heal a friend
Bring Jesus to the high priest

cards.text: They open with compliments. They call Him Teacher and say He's honest, He seeks favor from no one, and He teaches the way of God in truth. Friend, NOBODY has ever said "you're so honest" to me and then asked me something easy.

cards.question: After all that praise, what do the Pharisees and Herodians ask Jesus?

answers.text: Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar
Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath
Is it lawful for a man to divorce

cards.text: Caesar is the Roman emperor, and they want a straight answer: "Should we pay them or not?" Yes or no, Teacher. No pressure.

cards.question: Jesus takes the kind words of the Pharisees and Herodians at face value.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Jesus asks them, "Why are you testing Me?" Then He tells them, "Bring Me a denarius to inspect."

cards.question: They bring Jesus the denarius. What does He ask them about the coin?

answers.text: Whose image and inscription are on it
How much the coin is really worth
Who gave them the coin to bring

cards.question: Whose image and inscription are on the denarius?

answers.text: Caesar's
Herod's
Pilate's

cards.question: So should they pay taxes to Caesar? What does Jesus tell them?

answers.text: Give Caesar what is Caesar's and God what is God's
Give Caesar nothing and give it all to God
Pay Caesar first and give God what is left

cards.question: The Pharisees and Herodians came to catch Jesus in His words. How do they react to His answer?

answers.text: They marvel at Him
They pick up stones
They laugh at Him

cards.text: Next up, the Sadducees come to question Jesus. They're Jewish leaders who say there is no resurrection. Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer and nobody asked me a single thing, and this Man has people lining UP.
They remind Jesus of something Moses wrote: if a man dies and leaves a wife but no children, his brother is to marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.

cards.question: In the Sadducees' story there are seven brothers. The first marries and dies with no children. What does the second brother do?

answers.text: He marries the widow
He moves to another town
He goes to the priest

cards.text: The third brother does the same, and on it goes, all the way down to brother number seven. Friend, this isn't a question anymore, this is a seven-season TV drama.

cards.question: In the Sadducees' story, one of the seven brothers finally leaves a child.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Last of all, the woman dies too. Seven husbands, one widow, and now the Sadducees have their question ready.

cards.question: What do the Sadducees ask Jesus about the woman?

answers.text: Whose wife will she be in the resurrection
Which of the brothers she loved the most
Where her seven husbands should be buried

cards.question: Jesus tells the Sadducees they're mistaken. What two things does He say they don't know?

answers.text: The Scriptures and the power of God
The law and the words of the prophets
The temple and the ways of the priests

cards.question: Jesus says that when the dead rise, they still marry.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Jesus says the dead who rise won't marry. Instead, who will they be like?

answers.text: The angels in heaven
The prophets of old
The stars in the sky

cards.text: Then Jesus points them to the burning bush in the Book of Moses, where God told Moses, "I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." They brought Moses to the debate, so Jesus brings Moses right back.

cards.question: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, Israel's forefathers, died long before God spoke to Moses at the burning bush. What does Jesus say this shows about God?

answers.text: He is God of the living not the dead
He chose Israel above all the nations
Abraham Isaac and Jacob are gone for good

cards.text: Then Jesus wraps it up: "You are badly mistaken!" Friend, I've been told I was mistaken PLENTY of times, but never with "badly" parked right in front of it.

One of the scribes, a teacher of the law, has come up and heard the whole debate, and he notices how well Jesus answered. You know that one person in the meeting who's actually paying attention? That's this guy.

cards.question: The scribe has heard how well Jesus answered. What does he ask Jesus?

answers.text: Which commandment is the most important
What must I do to inherit eternal life
Who then can be saved by God

cards.text: Jesus begins His answer right here: "Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One."

cards.question: Right after saying the Lord is One, what does Jesus give as the most important commandment?

answers.text: Love the Lord your God with everything
Keep the Sabbath and make it holy
Bring your offerings to the temple

cards.text: Jesus spells it out: with all your heart, all your soul, all your mind and all your strength. Friend, God isn't asking for one cookie off the tray, He's asking for the WHOLE box.

cards.question: The scribe asked for one commandment, but Jesus gives him a second one too. What is it?

answers.text: Love your neighbor as yourself
Honor your father and mother
Do not bear false witness

cards.question: Jesus tells the scribe that some other commandment is greater than these two.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: The scribe answers, "Right, Teacher," and says back that God is One and there is no other but Him. After two rounds of tough questions, somebody finally just AGREES with Jesus.

cards.question: The scribe says loving God and loving your neighbor as yourself is more important than what?

answers.text: All burnt offerings and sacrifices
All the scrolls of the prophets
All the gold in the temple

cards.question: Jesus sees that the scribe has answered ___.

answers.text: wisely
foolishly
falsely

cards.question: What does Jesus tell the scribe?

answers.text: You are not far from the kingdom of God
Go and sell everything that you own
Leave everything and follow Me right now

cards.text: And after that, no one dares to question Jesus any further. Three rounds of questions, and now? Crickets.
